left.description: The left page's frame. Every x is measured from the frame's left rule.

width.description: From the frame's left rule to its right rule.

levels.description: The staircase of the subject column, outermost first: the level and the column its code starts in.

subject_amounts.description: The amount columns of every subject row, with their heading in the shared dictionary.

funding.description: The 財源内訳 column (source names and amounts), not taken in.

setsu.description: The 節 区分 column: the 節 code and name.

setsu_amount.description: The 節 金額 column and its heading in the shared dictionary.

right.description: The facing page's frame of one column (説明). Every x is measured from the frame's left rule.

pattern.description: The start of the item's line (its words joined).

amount.description: The item prints its amount at the right end of its line.

bullet.description: A mark that opens the name, in place of a code.

code.description: The code and the name of the item as the two groups of a pattern (default: the leading digits and the rest).

items.description: The kinds of explanation item, outermost first; a kind nests in the kinds before it that are open.

amount_left.description: An item's amount ends right of this x.

prose_indent.description: A line of prose starting right of this x is a quantity line under an item.

aside_heading.description: A line (its words joined) heading the item above cut another way (`（選挙執行内訳）`): the lines under it up to the next item are not taken in.

abolished_mark.description: The mark a subject prints in place of its code when its amount this year is none (`△物価高騰…`).

divider_text.description: A page without a frame whose digits are this regex (compacted text) is a divider and is skipped; any other one stops.
